name: Mnemonic Images for Learning Written Chinese

mentions.name: Mnemonic Images for Learning Written Chinese
mentions.description: A free collection of mnemonic images for learning written Chinese. Each image is solarpunk-styled and references both the character's meaning and its pictographic etymology, with the character overlaid and color-coded to indicate its tonality in Mandarin.
mentions.audience: People learning written Chinese; intended as a free educational resource for whoever might want it
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a collection of mnemonic images for learning written Chinese. Each has a solarpunk-style image referencing both the character's meaning and pictographic etymology, with the character overlaid and color-coded to indicate the tonality in Mandarin.
